India Experiences Widespread Monsoon Rains and Alerts

India is experiencing significant monsoon activity with heavy rainfall reported across various regions, including Mumbai, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh. Several areas have issued alerts, with some cities like Mumbai and Himachal Pradesh experiencing school closures due to the downpour. The monsoon's arrival and intensity are impacting daily life and prompting weather warnings.
